typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename2 as string (),
	tblGSFDailyWFSIWFBNReportAnalystsMapping_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CreatedBy as string,
		{Full Name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp())),
		Filename = toString(($sFilename2))) ~> LoadDateFilename
LoadDateFilename sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		CreatedBy as string,
		FullName as string,
		Filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		CreatedBy,
		FullName = {Full Name},
		Filename),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblGSFDailyWFSIWFBNReportAnalystsMapping_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblGSFDailyWFSIWFBNReportAnalystsMapping
